summary: Frontend-only verification of the new JARVIS Aura v3 sidebar navigation replacing the bottom tab bar. Tested BOTH mobile (390x844) and tablet (1024x768) viewports after quick-login as Kishan Sir. TABLET: 100% PASS on all bullets — sidebar-dock docks left at 220 px, no hamburger, all 6 nav items present in exact order (overview/shipments/invoices/ledger/trips/more) with correct y-positions [127,179,231,283,335,387], clicking sidebar-nav-shipments navigates to /shipments and moves the active state (3px green left border + rgba(0,255,136,0.10) bg), sidebar-toggle collapses to 64 px and re-expands to 220 px, quick-stats hidden when collapsed & visible when expanded, content pane paddingLeft matches sidebar width (220 seen), sidebar glass background = rgba(5, 3, 15, 0.75) with backdrop-filter blur(40px) saturate(1.8), 9 white shiny particles (1-3 px, opacity 0.3-0.6) counted inside dock, header shows 'LogiOp Pro' in #00FF88 neon-green + CompanySwitcher + FYPicker, bottom shows Kishan Sir + ADMIN role. MOBILE: PARTIAL PASS with 1 P0 blocker — tab bar (tab-index/tab-shipments/tab-invoices/tab-bullion/tab-more) completely removed (0 found), hamburger visible top-left, tapping hamburger animates drawer from x=-260 to x=0 in 300 ms, scrim renders full-viewport (0,0,390,844) with pointerEvents:auto, no left padding on content when drawer closed. HOWEVER the tap-outside-to-close and even the drawer's own nav items are NON-INTERACTIVE because the mobile drawer and scrim are painted BEHIND the content pane. document.elementFromPoint at every probed coordinate (10,10 / 100,400 / 200,400 / 280,400 / 350,500 / 370,700) returns dashboard content (Welcome back / Bangkok warehouse / view shipments / stat-Delivered) instead of the scrim or drawer. Real mouse click on the visually-open drawer's Shipments item at (130,203) navigated to /ledger (hit the 'ledger-get-card' underneath) instead of /shipments. Only JS-dispatched click events on the scrim element close the drawer, proving the handler is wired but the element is unreachable. No new console errors introduced.

ui_bugs.issue: Mobile drawer and scrim are rendered BEHIND the content pane. Real mouse/touch events pass through them to the dashboard. Confirmed by (a) elementFromPoint at any (x,y) in the viewport returns dashboard content, never sidebar-scrim/sidebar-mobile-drawer; (b) clicking the visible Shipments row inside the drawer at (130,203) navigated to /ledger because a ledger-get-card sat underneath. Only the hamburger works because it has an explicit web zIndex:20 in styles.hamburger. Root cause: in /app/frontend/src/components/sidebar.tsx `MobileSidebar` returns a Fragment of 3 position:absolute siblings; they render BEFORE the content pane <View> in _layout.tsx AuthShell's flex row. Both siblings are position:relative/absolute with zIndex:0, and DOM-later positioned siblings win the stacking, so the content pane paints on top of the drawer/scrim. Fix: add web zIndex (≥ 25) to the scrim's Animated.View and the drawer's Animated.View in styles (Platform.select web:{zIndex:25} / web:{zIndex:26}) so they sit above the content pane. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/sidebar.tsx:446-471, /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx:70-83.

rca_of_issue: Bug: Mobile drawer + scrim are visually rendered but not clickable — real pointer events pass through to the dashboard content behind. Reproduction: viewport 390x844 → login as Kishan → tap [data-testid=sidebar-hamburger] → drawer visually slides to x=0 → tap any visible nav item OR any spot to the right of the drawer → drawer does NOT close AND nav does NOT switch. Clicking Shipments row at (130, 203) navigates to /ledger because a ledger-get-card element sits underneath in the paint order. RCA: In /app/frontend/src/components/sidebar.tsx `MobileSidebar` returns a React Fragment of three position:absolute nodes (hamburger, scrim Animated.View, drawer Animated.View). These render as the first children of AuthShell's flex row in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx before the content pane <View>{children}</View>. All are position:absolute/relative with zIndex:0/auto. Per CSS stacking, when two positioned siblings share the same z-index, the later one in DOM wins — so the content pane (a positioned subtree with lots of stacked cards) paints ON TOP of the drawer/scrim. Only the hamburger works because styles.hamburger explicitly sets web zIndex:20. Mitigation: Add matching Platform.select({web:{zIndex:25}}) to styles for the scrim's Animated.View and Platform.select({web:{zIndex:26}}) to the drawer's Animated.View (or higher, provided they stay above the content but below the Toast/BlockerBell/FloatingJarvis at root which need to remain top-most).
